title: The Man Who Can Fix Anything

pre.en: What is the one thing Mr Okafor has never been able to fix?
pre.zh: Okafor 先生唯一一直没修好的东西是什么？

intro: 一篇人物小传：每周六，社区图书馆变成「修理咖啡馆」，志愿者免费帮人修东西，其中最受欢迎的是退休工程师 Okafor 先生。读的时候留意说能力的几种说法：can、could、managed to、was able to——尤其是「过去某一次做成了」该用哪一个。

sentences.en: So, every Saturday our local library turns into a repair café.
sentences.zh: 每到周六，我们这儿的图书馆就变成一家「修理咖啡馆」。

sentences.en: Volunteers fix things that people would normally throw away, and they do it for free.
sentences.zh: 志愿者帮大家修那些本来要扔掉的东西，而且一分钱不收。

sentences.en: The most popular volunteer is Mr Okafor, a retired engineer.
sentences.zh: 最受欢迎的志愿者是 Okafor 先生，一位退休工程师。

sentences.en: He can fix anything with a screw or a battery.
sentences.zh: 只要带螺丝或者电池的东西，他都能修。

sentences.en: At ten, he could already take a radio apart and put it back together.
sentences.zh: 他十岁就会把收音机拆开再装回去。

sentences.en: Last week, a woman brought in a toaster that broke down after just one week.
sentences.zh: 上周，一位女士拿来一台烤面包机，才用了一个星期就坏了。

sentences.en: A man brought his late father's fifty-year-old radio.
sentences.zh: 还有一位男士，带来了他已故父亲留下的一台五十年的老收音机。

sentences.en: Mr Okafor managed to fix the toaster in ten minutes, in front of a small crowd.
sentences.zh: 当着一小群围观的人，Okafor 先生十分钟就把烤面包机修好了。

sentences.en: The radio took all morning, but in the end he was able to fix that too.
sentences.zh: 收音机花了一整个上午，不过最后也修好了。

sentences.en: When it started playing again, its owner couldn't speak.
sentences.zh: 收音机重新响起来的时候，它的主人激动得说不出话。

sentences.en: You don't have to book.
sentences.zh: 不用预约。

sentences.en: Just turn up with whatever's broken.
sentences.zh: 东西坏了，直接拿过来就行。

sentences.en: Younger volunteers who want to learn give him a hand.
sentences.zh: 想学手艺的年轻志愿者会给他打下手。

sentences.en: He keeps every old screw in a biscuit tin, because "it'll come in handy one day".
sentences.zh: 每一颗旧螺丝他都留着，装在一个饼干盒里，因为「总有一天用得上」。

sentences.en: And he looks after every broken thing like it's his own.
sentences.zh: 每一件坏了的东西，他都当自己的一样爱惜。

sentences.en: Well, word has got around, and people now come from three towns away.
sentences.zh: 这下名声传开了，现在连隔着三个镇的人都专门跑来。

sentences.en: Actually, a lot of them bring things they nearly got rid of.
sentences.zh: 其实，很多人拿来的都是差点就扔了的东西。

sentences.en: He's proud of every single repair.
sentences.zh: 每修好一件，他都很自豪。

sentences.en: "If you do it properly, it's as good as new," he says.
sentences.zh: 「修得好，就跟新的一样，」他说。

sentences.en: There's only one thing he's never been able to fix: the café's coffee machine.
sentences.zh: 只有一样东西，他一直没修好：咖啡馆的咖啡机。

sentences.en: "Some things are better broken," he says with a grin.
sentences.zh: 「有些东西还是坏着好，」他咧嘴一笑，

sentences.en: "Otherwise people would stay all day."
sentences.zh: 「不然大家会在这儿待上一整天。」

cards.note: 也能当动词：volunteer at a library 在图书馆做志愿者。重音在最后：vol-un-TEER。
to get rid of something you don't want, usually by putting it in the bin
cards.tip: 代词放中间：throw it away；它说的就是「扔进垃圾桶」，比 get rid of 具体。
cards.example: Don't throw away the box — we might need it for returns.

cards.note: without having to pay, or without being paid
cards.tip: for free 放在动词后面：work for free、get it for free；当形容词直接说 free：The app is free.
cards.example: You can use the app for free for the first month.

cards.note: 动词 retire 退休，名词 retirement 退休（生活）。
螺丝刀是 screwdriver；动词 screw 是「拧」。
toast 烤面包片，-er 表示做这件事的机器，同类的还有 printer、heater。
to stop working, used about machines and cars
cards.tip: 主语是机器或车，后面不接宾语；名词 a breakdown 是「故障」。
cards.example: Our car broke down on the way to the airport.

cards.note: 放在名词前、指人时是「已故的」：my late grandmother。别和第 16 课「迟到」的 late 搞混。
where someone can see or hear you; in a position before someone or something
a small crowd 一小群人；crowded 拥挤的。
after a long time, or after a lot of problems
to arrive, often late or when people are not sure you will come
to help someone, especially with a practical job
cards.tip: 人放在 give 后面：give me a hand；帮着做什么用 with：give sb a hand with sth。
cards.example: Can you give me a hand with these boxes?

cards.note: to be useful, especially when you did not expect it to be
cards.tip: 常和 will、might 连用，说「以后可能有用」；过去分词还是 come。
cards.example: Keep the old charger — it might come in handy.

cards.note: to take care of someone or something and keep them safe and well
cards.tip: 第 12 课是照看孩子和小店；照看的对象也可以是别人的东西，意思就成了「爱惜」。
cards.example: Who looks after your plants when you travel for work?

cards.zh: 消息传开；一传十，十传百
cards.note: used to say that news spreads quickly from person to person
to throw away, sell or give away something you do not want
cards.tip: 范围比 throw away 大：送人、卖掉、扔掉都算；过去式是 got rid of。
cards.example: We finally got rid of the old printer.

cards.note: to feel pleased and satisfied about something you have done or own
cards.tip: of 后面接让人自豪的事或人，也可以接 doing：proud of finishing on time。
cards.example: I'm really proud of the app we built this year.

cards.note: in very good condition again, almost like something new
cards.tip: 常跟 be、look、work 连用：It looks as good as new.
cards.example: After the repair, my laptop is as good as new.

cards.note: 常放句首，意思相当于 if not：Hurry, otherwise we'll miss the train.
